name: doh
description: Skills: /implementNewFeature (feature pipeline with browser stepper UI), /codeReview (deterministic instruction-driven code review, interactive HTML reports) /fixPr (fixes the open comments of a pull request and its red lint/typecheck/test/build in a background worktree per branch) and /restack (moves a stack of pull requests onto its newest base, bottom-up, a conflict agent for real conflicts). Every skill runs in lean mode: caveman ultra for the orchestrator and each of its sub-agents, headroom context compression when the proxy is installed
